items.title: U.S. Agencies Warn of Hackers Targeting Industrial Refrigeration to Disrupt Food and Medicine Storage
items.description: CISA, FBI, HHS, USDA, and DOT have warned that hackers are targeting industrial refrigeration and cold chain monitoring systems worldwide, putting food, medicine, and other temperature-sensitive goods at risk. items.title: CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a high-severity vulnerability impacting SonicWall SonicOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports that it said may have been exploited in real-world attacks. items.title: Hackers Begin Exploiting OpenSSH SSHole Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.description: Attackers have started targeting the SSHole authentication bypass affecting certain OpenSSH servers, according to new SANS Internet Storm Center findings. The flaw allows remote attackers to access some password-disabled Linux accounts by submitting an unusually long password, without knowing valid credentials or holding an SSH key. items.title: Critical React Server Components Flaw Lets Hackers Execute Code Remotely Without Authentication
items.description: A critical security flaw in React Server Components can let attackers run code remotely without logging in. React published the advisory, tracked as GHSA-xqc2-xf4c-x3h3, on October 14, 2026. The issue carries a CVSS v4 score of 9.5, and the React team recommends immediate updates for affected applications.
